title: Only one Bluetooth device for 'speak reading' ?
body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/2548
Originally posted by **bjarkih1977** December 12, 2022 I'm having a bit of trouble with bluetooth devices and vehicle mode/speak readings. I love having the function of xDrip reading the values to me when connected to bluetooth audio while e.g driving. Problem is that I use another BT device at work and xDrip doesn't seem to store the info on both so at the start of work I have to pair xDrip to my work BT audio and vice versa after work when starting up the car. Any suggestions? Other apps on the phone are fine switching between BT devices.

comments.body: Hi, I just set up an xdrip profile in Tasker to connect to earbuds or my car. Works very well. You could probably do this in any automation app, but xdrip is  well integrated in Tasker.

Connecting the phone to the car audio isn't the problem.  The issue is that the xDrip app only seems to allow for one receiver overall.  Instead of e.g having a list of them to select from automatically.  I find this strange since all audio players on the phone just follow the bluetooth output automatically.  It's just this special car-mode that gets in the way.

Hi, technically this isn't about xDrip forming a Bluetooth connection with the car. It is about xDrip triggering functions in it based on the presence of Bluetooth connection. That is, when you are connected to car Bluetooth, xDrip can enable Text to Speech automatically, or some other functions.

Personally I am only interested in enabling Text to Speech when specified Bluetooth connections are detected. For example, I would like to enable Text to Speech any time I use either my own or my wife's car, but also when I put on headphones or earbuds or whatever.

That said, for me it would be enough if this "Detect car audio" had a list of Bluetooth MAC addresses instead of just one. I can understand it would become cumbersome to add different profiles to enable different set of features depending on which device you connect to. Having a list of devices would suffice my use case perfectly.

I'm a little bit confused by this.
I don't believe it is xDrip that pairs to a Bluetooth device.  It is the phone that pairs with a device.  And your phone must have a list of Bluetooth devices.  

Is it possible that your phone deletes any Bluetooth device as soon as the link is not used?

Yes, the Bluetooth connection is completely handled by the phone. xDrip is only following from the phone which devices it has the Bluetooth connection enabled to.

That part works well, but you can only specify one Bluetooth device that triggers the vehicle mode. If you have two cars and you would like to enable vehicle mode when in either of them, you can only choose one of them. For this to work with multiple Bluetooth devices, there would need to be a list of MAC addresses in "learn current car audio" xDrip that enable vehicle mode. Not just one like there is now.

As I said previously on this thread, you can easily use Tasker to be able to trigger multiple Bluetooth connections that you have. It is very simple to create a single profile to trigger any Bluetooth connection made. For instance, I have 3 sets of earbuds and a car listed to start "speak readings" whenever any one of them is connected, and turn off "speak readings" when they are disconnected.

@bjarkih1977 Can you try a different phone?
Do you experience the same issue?

> Connecting the phone to the car audio isn't the problem. The issue is that the xDrip app only seems to allow for one receiver overall.

@bjarkih1977 @Navid200 
Not sure when this changed, but I am seeing the opposite now: On latest versions (current version = 20240419) xDrip+ started speaking readings to *any* BT device selected?

Edit: Please ignore: I found this issue discussed at https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/3219

@bjarkih1977 I don't believe you can pair xDrip with anything.
It is your phone that pairs, or unpairs.

Please test this with another phone and let me know if you experience the same thing.
In the meantime, I am closing this issue.
We can always reopen if needed.
